messages:
Priya Nair: Quick postmortem follow-up  we need to finalize the customer comms decisions: exact statuspage phrasing, RCA sharing consent flow, and when recurring small flaps trigger an email to subscribers. I created a compact tracker: https://ourdocs.internal/incidents/INC-2026-522/tracker :clipboard:

ops-bot: Postmortem uploaded: https://ourdocs.internal/incidents/INC-2026-522/postmortem (owner: @Priya Nair) :page_facing_up:

Marco Alvarez: For statuspage phrasing I propose a minimal two-label system: "Operational" and "Service disruption." Use quantitative thresholds in the template: service disruption = user errors >=0.75% for >7m OR p95 latency >2.5s for >10m. Keeps copy short and avoids label proliferation.

Ellen Park: I like short labels. For customer-facing summaries, draft a 72h redacted summary by default. But add a consent checkbox in the tracker for customers who opted into technical RCAs: they should automatically get the full RCA (no NDA) if they opted in at signup. For others, full RCA on request under NDA or EA within 10 business days.

Priya Nair: Good point on consent. Let's add a column in the tracker: "customer_consent_rca" and a simple flow: if true -> auto-send full RCA link when published; if false -> include instructions to request the full RCA. We'll tag Legal to vet consent language.

Marco Alvarez: On redactions: maintain tri-signoff (Security + Incident Owner + Legal) for external publish, but allow Security to sign-off internal-only redactions with a logged "exception_reason". Add a small approval webhook so approvers can sign off within the tracker. Example curl snippet for the webhook: ```curl -X POST https://approvals.internal/approve -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"incident":"INC-2026-522","approver":"security@redwood.com","type":"redaction"}'```

Ellen Park: For recurring flaps, recommend stricter automation: if the same subsystem has >=2 incidents within 14 days, mark as "recurring" and send an automated summary email to impacted subscribers with subject "Repeated disruption notice" and open a follow-up ticket (A5). The threshold is lower because flaps have been noisy and customers value early notice. I'll own the detection job and weekly digest.

Priya Nair: OK compromise. Add tracker fields: "recurring_count", "recurring_window_days", "auto_email_on_recurrence". Marco can you add the cron to the tracker?

Marco Alvarez: Done. Cron sample I use: ```# weekly recurrence job
0 5 * * Mon /usr/local/bin/recurrence-check --incident INC-2026-522 --window 14d --threshold 2 --out /tmp/inc-522.json || echo "recurrence job failed" | mail -s "recurrence job" ops@redwood.com```

Ellen Park: I'll also prepare a short statuspage blurb for the 72h summary: 

Ellen Park: ```Between 03:12 and 03:26 UTC we observed a service disruption affecting inference proxy routing. Root cause: a config regression in the routing rules. Impact: ~1.1% of requests returned errors. Remediation: rolled back the change and validated traffic. We will publish a redacted summary within 72 hours and make the full RCA available to consenting customers or on request under existing agreements.```

Marco Alvarez: That reads clearly. Legal, can you confirm consent language is OK? tagging @legal-bot

legal-bot: Legal note: consent opt-in language should be explicit and reversible. We'll provide a short template for the tracker and review the final summary before publish. Tag legal@redwood.com for review.

Priya Nair: Action owners recap from tracker: A1 statuspage copy & thresholds  Marco to finalize; A2 consent and tracker fields  Priya to add + Legal review; A3 redaction approval webhook  Marco to implement; A4 recurrence detection job + digest  Ellen to implement and send weekly; A5 follow-up deep-dive ticket auto-open on recurrence  ops to auto-create.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: A2 consent fields + legal review due 2026-09-10T12:00:00Z (owner: Priya Nair).

Ellen Park: I'll aim to run a first recurrence digest on 2026-09-14 and will link the first automated email in the tracker if triggered.

Priya Nair: Thanks all. I'll update the postmortem template tonight with the new fields: "public_deadline_default", "consent_rca_field", "recurrence_threshold" and will ping for a final review in 24h. :white_check_mark:
